name: Khanmigo
tagline: Khanmigo is Khan Academy's AI-powered tutor built on GPT-4. Rather than giving answers directly, it uses the Socratic method to guide students through problems with questions and hints. It also serves as a teacher assistant, helping educators generate lesson plans, assignment rubrics, and progress reports.
